scientific_witness.independent_mathematical_rule: For a previously seen symbol, current rank equals count of symbols whose last occurrence is more recent. For a never-seen symbol w, rank=w+count(previously seen symbols greater than w). Final alphabet sorts seen symbols by decreasing recency, then unseen symbols ascending. This represents state as256 last-occurrence timestamps, independently of mutable-alphabet encoder movement.
scientific_witness.decoder_rule: Start ascending256byte alphabet; decoded symbol is alphabet[rank], then move chosen symbol to front. Every position is checked against original input.
